verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Mixpanel's event tracking, GDPR/EU data residency, and privacy APIs, but nowhere claims cookieless tracking or explicitly addresses avoiding cookie consent banners. Community comments even flag PII/session-replay leakage risks, but no source states how Mixpanel identifies users without cookies. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cookieless/first-party identification method, and any claim about reducing cookie-consent banner requirements.
